message.content:
This vertical illustration shows a scene featuring two main figures against a dark background, framed within the masthead of "TEMPO" magazine. On the left stands a woman dressed as Little Red Riding Hood, wearing a bright red hooded cloak over a blue skirt with white horizontal stripes and grey stockings. She carries a dark, woven basket. Her expression is somber as she reaches toward a set of light-colored, draped curtains.

On the right, a large wolf-like creature wearing round-rimmed glasses and a dark cap peers from behind the curtains. The wolf has grey fur, sharp white teeth, and visible claws. It is dressed in a tan garment, a blue skirt, and a patterned red and white sarong-style cloth at the bottom, with black shoes visible.

Text at the top includes "PASAL ZOMBIE BAGI PENGHINA PRESIDEN" and "MAJU-MUNDUR TENAGA NUKLIR." In the center-right, large white text reads "OPERASI MENGHADANG RISMA," followed by smaller text: "Benarkah ia dijegal agar Surabaya bisa ditaklukkan cukong besar?" A barcode and price "RP 39.500" are at the bottom left.
